verdictSemantics.description: The declared meaning of each verdict for THIS suite (the design law: a suite declares what each verdict establishes). All four declarations are mandatory non-empty text.

description: The verdict semantics object: the declared meaning of pass / conditional-pass / fail / unknown for a specific suite (the design law: a suite declares what each verdict establishes). The verdict vocabulary itself is the closed enum pass | conditional-pass | fail | unknown — it has no quantitative members and cannot carry graded values.
title: Arena certification-verdict v1
